selected_script.angle: A damp microfiber cloth on the greasy microwave exterior handle only spreads fingerprints and cooking film into cloudy streaks; Liapu enters as the targeted degreaser spray that cuts the same sticky film and wipes clean with a clear touch-test result.
selected_script.hook: My damp cloth was just turning this greasy microwave handle into streaks.

timeline.0-3s: Extreme close-up of a greasy microwave exterior handle and door edge with fingerprints and yellowish cooking film; a damp microfiber cloth rubs the spot but the grease turns into cloudy streaks instead of lifting.
timeline.3-6s: The same cloth keeps wiping harder across the same handle area, visibly spreading the oily film wider, leaving wet residue and frustrating smears under the kitchen light.
timeline.6-10s: The Liapu 500ml Kitchen Spray enters naturally from the counter, sprays the same greasy handle area, then the hand wipes once slowly to reveal a clean, non-cloudy section; the camera holds a stable before-after contrast between the freshly cleaned strip and untouched greasy edge, ending with a light CTA.

script_record.voiceover: I kept wiping this microwave handle with a damp cloth, but it just smeared the grease around. Then I tried Liapu. Spray, wipe, and look — clean, no greasy film. Try it on your kitchen mess.

scenes.promptText:
Create one complete approximately 10-second vertical 9:16 US-market TikTok-style UGC cleaning-product ad, realistic handheld phone-shot style in a modern American kitchen with natural indoor light, slight hand movement, real household surfaces, natural wiping and spray sounds. Do not create separate scenes or separate clips; keep this as one continuous short video with natural jump-cut pacing inside the same video.

Product identity must be preserved from the reference image: Liapu 500ml Kitchen Spray Cleaner & Degreaser, white smooth plastic cylindrical spray bottle, standard 500ml proportions, translucent bottle showing liquid level, trigger sprayer mechanism with nozzle, ergonomic grip, yellow front-center label reading CLEAN UP KITCHEN OIL STAINS and NET: 500ml. Keep the product color, label placement, shape, plastic material, proportions, nozzle structure, and visible bottle structure unchanged. Do not add any extra buttons, lights, screens, cords, attachments, decorative parts, or invented accessories to the product.

0-3s: Start with an extreme close-up of a stainless steel microwave exterior handle and the vertical door edge next to it. The handle has believable yellowish cooking grease, fingerprint buildup, and a tacky cloudy film from daily kitchen use. A real hand uses a damp gray microfiber cloth, a familiar ordinary cleaning method, and rubs the greasy handle in short strokes. Instead of cleaning, the cloth visibly drags the oil into cloudy streaks and leaves wet smears. The failure must be understandable even with no audio.

3-6s: Continue on the same microwave handle area from nearly the same close-up angle. The hand keeps wiping harder with the same damp microfiber cloth, pressing and scrubbing back and forth. The grease spreads wider across the handle and onto the door edge, creating more streaks, shiny residue, and uneven cloudy patches under the kitchen light. Show subtle frustration through the hand pausing and the cloth being lifted to reveal residue still there. No exaggerated dirt, no absurd mess, just a realistic greasy film that ordinary wiping fails to remove.

6-10s: The Liapu bottle enters naturally from the nearby kitchen counter into the same handheld frame, label facing camera briefly and clearly. The hand aims the trigger sprayer at the exact same greasy microwave handle area and sprays 2 quick pumps. Show a realistic fine mist and liquid wetting the oily film; no magical glow, no dramatic chemical reaction, no exaggerated foam. The hand wipes once slowly with a clean section of cloth or paper towel across the sprayed area, revealing a visibly cleaner, clearer stainless steel strip. Finish with a stable close-up result proof: part of the handle/door edge is clean and non-cloudy while a small adjacent untouched edge still shows the earlier greasy streaks, creating a natural before-after contrast in one frame, not a split screen. End with the product held beside the cleaned microwave handle, yellow label facing camera, and a light CTA feeling like a real recommendation.

Conversational American English voiceover, natural UGC tone: "I kept wiping this microwave handle with a damp cloth, but it just smeared the grease around. Then I tried Liapu. Spray, wipe, and look — clean, no greasy film. Try it on your kitchen mess."

Strict negatives: no platform UI, no TikTok interface, no subtitles, no captions, no stickers, no text overlays, no watermarks, no logos other than the real product label, no poster layout, no split-screen, no arrows, no floating callouts, no before-after graphic, no germ icons, no percentage graphics, no invented product features, no product drift, no magical cleanup, no exaggerated chemical effects, no unrealistic instant disappearance before wiping, no change to product category, no color shift, no label relocation, no altered bottle shape, no extra sprayer parts. Keep the action physically credible: spray wets the grease, wiping removes it, and the result is clean but realistic.
